Gangwon Province · Zuid-Korea (Nederlands)

Gangneung (강릉) — Zuid-Korea Reisgids: Bezienswaardigheden, Bereikbaarheid & Eten

East coast pine beaches, Ojukheon heritage house, Chodang tofu village and Anmok coffee street.

Regio / ProvincieGangwon Province
Beste ReistijdApr–Jun & Sep–Oct
Stay1–2 days

Overzicht

Gangneung (강릉) is one of the essential stops in South Korea, located in the Gangwon Province region. East coast pine beaches, Ojukheon heritage house, Chodang tofu village and Anmok coffee street.

With direct connections via KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail, Gangneung rewards a stay of 1–2 days so you can balance major landmarks with neighborhood cafés, markets, and easy half-day excursions.

Wat te Zien & Doen

  • Gangneung Historic Center & Main Square: Signature highlight in Gangneung — reserve morning entry tickets online in peak season.
  • Gangneung National Museum & Cathedral: Signature highlight in Gangneung — reserve morning entry tickets online in peak season.
  • Gangneung Panoramic Viewpoint & Old Quarter: Signature highlight in Gangneung — reserve morning entry tickets online in peak season.

Lokale Keuken & Specialiteiten

  • Traditional Gangneung House Specialty: Iconic local specialty of Gangneung and the Gangwon Province region.
  • Regional Gangwon Province Market Dish: Iconic local specialty of Gangneung and the Gangwon Province region.
  • Artisanal Gangwon Province Pastry & Wine: Iconic local specialty of Gangneung and the Gangwon Province region.

Bereikbaarheid & Openbaar Vervoer

Gangneung is served by KORAIL KTX & SRT High-Speed Rail and intercity express trains as well as regional airport transfers. Book high-speed legs 2–6 weeks ahead for early-bird fares.

The historic core of Gangneung is best explored on foot, supplemented by contactless tap-to-pay metro, tram, or bus lines.

Waar te Verblijven

  • Budget: Well-connected hostels and guesthouses within a 10-minute walk of Gangneung's central station or metro lines.
  • Mid-range: Boutique 3-to-4-star hotels near the historic center and pedestrian promenade.
  • Luxury: Heritage 5-star grand hotels and design properties with concierge access and views.
